## Overview
• Manages patient admissions, EMR, scheduling, and billing for clinics via a hybrid cloud architecture.
• Ensures HIPAA/GDPR compliance, high availability (99.99%), and long-term data retention.

## Key Elements
• **Actors & Systems:** Patients, Doctors, Administrators, Identity Provider (OIDC/SAML), Third-Party Billing Gateway, External Lab/Imaging Systems (HL7 FHIR), Notification Gateway, Cloud Backup Archive.
• **Containers:** React SPA Frontend, Envoy/Nginx API Gateway, Core Services (Go/Spring Boot), Integration Service (Apache Kafka/Camel), Distributed SQL Database (CockroachDB/Aurora), Async Message Broker (Kafka/RabbitMQ).

## Relationships
• **Client to Gateway:** HTTPS / WSS over TLS 1.3.
• **Internal Containers:** gRPC over mTLS; Kafka Protocol over TLS 1.3 for async messaging.
• **External Systems:** HTTPS / REST for billing; HL7 FHIR over REST/JSON for labs; S5 / HTTPS with AES-256 for cloud backups.

## Technology Stack
• **Kubernetes:** `on-prem-k8s` and AWS `eu-central-1` for hybrid active-active deployment.
• **CockroachDB / AWS Aurora:** Distributed SQL ensuring cross-region high availability.
• **Apache Kafka / RabbitMQ:** Async messaging for decoupling and performance.
• **Go / Java Spring Boot:** High-performance core microservices.

## Rationale
• Hybrid active-active replication and distributed SQL guarantee 99.99% uptime and low-latency EMR access.
• Strict protocol security (mTLS, TLS 1.3, AES-256) and FHIR interoperability satisfy healthcare compliance constraints.

containers.analysis:
## Overview
The Clinic Management System manages patient admissions, electronic medical records (EMR), scheduling, and billing for medium-sized clinics. It operates via a hybrid cloud deployment across on-premises Kubernetes and AWS (eu-central-1) to ensure high availability and compliance.

## Key Elements
- **Users**: Patients, Doctors, Administrators
- **Frontend Container**: Web Frontend (React/TypeScript)
- **Edge Container**: API Gateway (Kong/NGINX)
- **Core Containers**: Core Microservices (Go/Spring Boot), Background Worker (Go/Celery)
- **Integration Containers**: Integration Service (Apache Camel/Node.js), Message Broker (Apache Kafka/RabbitMQ)
- **Data & Caching Containers**: PostgreSQL, Object Storage (MinIO/S3), Caching & Session Container (Redis Enterprise)
- **Security & Ops Containers**: Audit & Compliance Logging (FluentBit/OpenSearch), Backup & Archive Manager (Velero/AWS Backup)
- **External Systems**: Identity Provider, Third-Party Billing Gateway, External Lab/Imaging Systems, Notification Gateway, Cloud Backup Archive

## Relationships
- Users -> **Web Frontend**: HTTPS
- **Web Frontend** -> **API Gateway**: HTTPS/JSON
- **API Gateway** -> **Core Services**: gRPC / Internal mTLS
- **Core Services** -> **PostgreSQL**: TLS
- **Core Services** -> **Caching & Session Container**: Redis Protocol / TLS
- **Core Services** -> **Message Broker**: AMQP / TLS
- **Message Broker** -> **Background Worker**: AMQP / TLS
- **Integration Service** -> **External Lab Systems**: HL7 FHIR over HTTPS
- **All Containers** -> **Audit & Compliance Logging**: Syslog / gRPC
- **Backup & Archive Manager** -> **Cloud Backup Archive**: HTTPS / TLS 1.3

## Technology Stack
- **API Gateway**: Kong or NGINX for TLS termination and OAuth2/OIDC token validation.
- **Frontend**: React and TypeScript served via NGINX.
- **Core Services**: Go and Spring Boot for domain microservices.
- **Data Layer**: PostgreSQL with AES-256 encryption for relational EMR/scheduling data; MinIO/S3 for medical imaging.
- **Caching**: Redis Enterprise in active-active mode for sub-second EMR performance and session management.
- **Messaging**: Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ active-active cluster for async events.
- **Integration**: Apache Camel or Node.js utilizing HL7 FHIR APIs.
- **Observability & Backup**: FluentBit/OpenSearch for audit logging; Velero/AWS Backup for 10-year data retention.

## Rationale
This architecture uses an active-active hybrid design with encrypted PostgreSQL and Redis caching to achieve 99.99% availability and sub-second EMR performance. Centralized audit logging, mTLS, and automated backup management ensure strict adherence to HIPAA and GDPR compliance mandates.

API Gateway.analysis:
## Overview
The Clinic Management System is a clinical IT platform that handles patient admissions, electronic medical records, scheduling, and billing for medium-sized hospitals. It utilizes a hybrid cloud architecture designed for high availability, security, and strict healthcare regulatory compliance.

## Key Elements
* Patients, Doctors, Administrators (Actors)
* Web Frontend (React / TypeScript / NGINX)
* API Gateway (Kong / NGINX) containing 6 internal components: TLS Termination & Routing Engine, Auth & Token Introspection Plugin, Rate Limiting & Threat Protection Component, Audit & Request Correlation Interceptor, Request Transformation & Payload Validation Engine, and Edge Caching & Session Store Component
* Core Microservices (Go / Spring Boot)
* Integration Service (Apache Camel / Node.js)
* Message Broker (Apache Kafka / RabbitMQ)
* PostgreSQL Database (AES-256 encrypted at rest)
* Redis Enterprise (Caching & Session Container)
* OpenSearch (Audit & Compliance Logging)
* Identity Provider, Third-Party Billing Gateway, External Lab/Imaging Systems

## Relationships
* Web Frontend -> API Gateway: Sends client requests [HTTPS / JSON]
* API Gateway -> Core Microservices: Routes validated traffic [gRPC / Internal mTLS]
* Auth & Token Introspection Plugin -> Identity Provider: Validates user tokens [HTTPS / OIDC]
* Audit & Request Correlation Interceptor -> Audit & Compliance Logging: Forwards access logs and security events [gRPC / mTLS]
* Integration Service -> External Lab/Imaging Systems: Interoperates via clinical standards [HL7 FHIR APIs]
* Core Microservices -> PostgreSQL Database: Persists clinical and patient records [TLS / SQL]

## Technology Stack
* Kong API Gateway: Selected for enterprise plugins, declarative configuration, and rate-limiting to meet 99.99% uptime constraints.
* Go & Spring Boot: Chosen for Core Microservices to ensure high-throughput and low-latency EMR screen loads.
* Apache Kafka & RabbitMQ: Implemented for asynchronous, reliable event-driven messaging across distributed services.
* PostgreSQL with AES-256: Used for persistent storage to satisfy strict HIPAA/GDPR encryption and data retention requirements.
* HL7 FHIR APIs: Adopted for seamless healthcare interoperability with external lab and imaging systems.

## Rationale
This hybrid cloud, microservices-based architecture guarantees 99.99% high availability through active-active deployments across on-premise Kubernetes and AWS eu-central-1. Furthermore, it strictly enforces HIPAA and GDPR compliance via edge-level OAuth2/OIDC token validation, mTLS service communication, and immutable audit logging.

## Overview
The Background Worker container executes asynchronous background tasks for the Clinic Management System to ensure high availability and HIPAA compliance. It manages asynchronous data processing, HL7 FHIR interoperability, and secure data persistence.

## Key Elements
- Job Consumer Component (Go / `goroutines`)
- Task Processor Component (Go)
- Data Access Component (Go / `database/sql`)
- Integration Dispatcher Component (Go)
- Retry & Dead-Letter Manager Component (Go)
- Encryption/Decryption Utility Component (Go / `crypto/aes`)
- Message Broker (Apache Kafka / RabbitMQ)
- PostgreSQL
- Integration Service (Apache Camel / Node.js)
- Object Storage (MinIO / S3)
- Audit & Compliance Logging (FluentBit / OpenSearch)

## Technology Stack
- Go (`goroutines`): Selected for high-throughput, low-latency concurrent background task processing.
- PostgreSQL with AES-256: Ensures secure, encrypted persistence meeting strict HIPAA compliance requirements.
- Apache Kafka / RabbitMQ: Provides reliable message brokering with AMQP/TLS protocols.
- S3 API (MinIO / AWS S3): Facilitates secure, long-term EMR data archiving and offloading.

## Rationale
This component architecture guarantees 99.99% availability by decoupling external system integrations and isolating transient failures through dedicated dead-letter management. Furthermore, it strictly enforces HIPAA and GDPR compliance via in-memory AES-256 cryptographic routines and comprehensive audit trails.

## Overview
The Clinic Management System is a hybrid cloud clinical IT solution designed to manage patient admissions, electronic medical records (EMR), scheduling, and billing for medium-sized hospitals and clinics. Its core purpose is to provide highly available, secure, and interoperable healthcare operations complying with HIPAA and GDPR regulations.

## Key Elements
- **Users**: Patients, Doctors, Administrators
- **External Systems**: Identity Provider, Third-Party Billing Gateway, External Lab/Imaging Systems, Notification Gateway, Cloud Backup Archive
- **Containers**: Web Frontend (React / TypeScript / NGINX), API Gateway (Kong / NGINX), Core Microservices (Go / Spring Boot), Background Worker (Go / Celery), Integration Service (Apache Camel / Node.js), Message Broker (Apache Kafka with KRaft), PostgreSQL (AES-256), Object Storage (MinIO / S3), Caching & Session Container (Redis Enterprise), Audit & Compliance Logging (FluentBit / OpenSearch), Backup & Archive Manager (Velero / AWS Backup)
- **Message Broker Components**: Kafka Broker Nodes (KRaft mode), Schema Registry, Kafka Connect, Kafka REST Proxy, Access Control List (ACL) Authorizer, Encryption & Key Manager, Partition Rebalancer / Controller, Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) Manager, Topic Mirroring Agent (MirrorMaker 2), Metrics & Telemetry Exporter

## Relationships
- **Core Microservices -> Message Broker**: Publishes domain events [TCP / TLS 1.3 (Kafka protocol)]
- **Message Broker -> Background Worker**: Consumes streaming events for asynchronous processing [TCP / TLS 1.3 (Kafka protocol)]
- **Integration Service -> Kafka REST Proxy**: Ingests external lab/imaging messages via authenticated HTTP [HTTPS / TLS 1.3]
- **ACL Authorizer -> Kafka Broker Nodes**: Validates client credentials and topic permissions [Internal gRPC / TLS 1.3]
- **Kafka Broker Nodes -> Encryption & Key Manager**: Encrypts sensitive EMR and demographic payloads at rest [Internal API / TLS 1.3]
- **Topic Mirroring Agent -> Kafka Broker Nodes**: Synchronizes partition logs bidirectionally across hybrid boundary [Kafka Protocol / TLS 1.3]
- **Message Broker -> Audit & Compliance Logging**: Streams audit trails and security events [gRPC / TLS 1.3]

## Technology Stack
- **Apache Kafka (KRaft mode)**: Selected for immutable append-only event logs, satisfying 10-year data retention and HIPAA audit requirements without ZooKeeper overhead.
- **TLS 1.3 & AES-256**: Ensures cryptographic transit security and data-at-rest protection for HIPAA/GDPR compliance.
- **Go / Spring Boot**: High-performance runtimes for Core Microservices and Background Workers ensuring low-latency EMR screen loads (< 1 s P95).
- **PostgreSQL & Redis Enterprise**: Provides robust relational persistence with AES-256 encryption and ultra-fast session caching.
- **MirrorMaker 2**: Enables active-active cross-site replication between on-premise Kubernetes and AWS (`eu-central-1`) to achieve 99.99% availability.

## Rationale
This architecture uses a hybrid cloud model with Apache Kafka to satisfy stringent 99.99% availability and 10-year data retention constraints. Component-level isolation via KRaft, strict ACLs, and end-to-end encryption ensure comprehensive HIPAA and GDPR compliance.

- **OpenSearch**: Provides searchable audit indexes with Index State Management (ISM) for WORM retention.

- **OTLP/gRPC over TLS 1.3 / mTLS**: Standardizes secure, encrypted telemetry transport.
- **AWS S3 API / MinIO**: Targets hybrid cloud storage for $\ge$ 10-year retention.

This architecture guarantees regulatory compliance and data integrity via automated PII/PHI sanitization, WORM storage policies, and tamper-evident cryptographic verification. ## Overview
This architecture defines the Backup & Archive Manager component of the Clinic Management System to ensure secure, compliant, and highly available long-term data management. It guarantees strict adherence to HIPAA, GDPR, and 10-year data retention mandates through automated encryption, key management, and data integrity verification.

## Key Elements
*   **Backup Management API Controller (Go)**: Inbound interface for administrative triggers, status monitoring, and manual overrides.
*   **Scheduler Engine (Go)**: Triggers automated snapshot and archival jobs based on compliance policies.
*   **Snapshot Agent (Velero-based)**: Captures consistent data states from Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, and MinIO.
*   **Encryption & Compliance Pipeline (Go)**: Enforces AES-256 encryption and sanitizes volatile session data.
*   **Retention Policy Enforcer (Go)**: Manages lifecycle rules and executes secure data purging.
*   **Integrity & Verification Service (Go)**: Performs automated restore drills and cryptographic hash validation.
*   **Key Management Intermediary (Go/Vault SDK)**: Manages archive-specific encryption keys and cryptographic deletion.
*   **External Systems**: Cloud Backup Archive, Audit & Compliance Logging (OpenSearch).

## Relationships
*   *API Gateway / Admin CLI* -> *Backup Management API Controller*: Forwards administrative commands [gRPC / mTLS]
*   *Backup Management API Controller* -> *Scheduler Engine*: Dispatches manual run requests [Internal gRPC]
*   *Scheduler Engine* -> *Snapshot Agent*: Triggers backups [Internal gRPC]
*   *Snapshot Agent* -> *Encryption & Compliance Pipeline*: Streams raw backup payloads [Internal Channel / Memory]
*   *Encryption & Compliance Pipeline* -> *Key Management Intermediary*: Fetches archive-specific encryption keys [Transit API / mTLS]
*   *Encryption & Compliance Pipeline* -> *Cloud Backup Archive*: Uploads encrypted archives [HTTPS / TLS 1.3]
*   *Retention Policy Enforcer* -> *Cloud Backup Archive*: Applies object lifecycle policies [S3 API / HTTPS]

*   *Scheduler Engine* -> *Integrity & Verification Service*: Triggers validation jobs [Internal gRPC]

*   *Backup Management API Controller* -> *Audit & Compliance Logging*: Emits security audit events [gRPC]

## Technology Stack
*   **Go**: Utilized across all internal components for high performance and low resource overhead during heavy snapshot operations.
*   **Velero / AWS Backup**: Powers snapshot creation and hybrid cloud object storage management.
*   **HashiCorp Vault SDK / Transit API**: Secures key rotation, encryption, and cryptographic deletion.
*   **gRPC & mTLS**: Ensures secure, high-performance internal communication and administrative transport.
*   **HTTPS / TLS 1.3 & S3 API**: Secures data transfer and object lifecycle management with the cloud archive.

## Rationale
This modular Go-based component architecture ensures minimal resource consumption during resource-intensive snapshot windows while strictly enforcing HIPAA and GDPR mandates. Proactive integrity verification and dedicated key management guarantee recoverability and secure 10-year data retention.
